sources.production: Independent static hinges, arrow glyphs and angle-specific leaf parts. No sprite rotation.

conveyor.rule: Arrow direction equals actual automatic displacement

oneway_gate.rule: Only the indicated displacement is allowed; opening folds towards that heading

bounce_corner.rule: 45-degree deflector turns forced movement90degrees with no extra action

brake_pad.rule: Stop forced movement in the same cell; no push/rebound/transport arrow
